description: Configure counting channels, rules and moderation settings here

content.name: channels
content.description: Channels in which users can participate in the counting game

content.name: channelDescription
content.description: Text which should be set after someone counted (leave blank to disable)

content.name: success-reaction
content.description: Reaction which the bot should give when someone counts successfully

content.name: restartOnWrongCount
content.description: If enabled, the game will restarts if a user sends a number that is not in order

content.name: restartOnWrongCountMessage
content.default: Due to the incompetence of %mention%, the game had to restart - the next number is **%i%**.
content.description: This message will be sent when the game gets restarted due to a miscount.

content.name: onlyOneMessagePerUser
content.humanName: Only one continuous message per user
content.description: If enabled, users can not count more than one number continuously

content.name: protectAgainstDeletion
content.humanName: Protect against users deleting the last counting message?
content.description: If enabled, the bot will send a message when the last correct counting message gets deleted so that other counters can't be fooled into counting an already counted number again.

content.name: protectionMessage
content.default: It seems like %mention% deleted their last message - the last counted number is **%number%**.
content.description: Message that gets send if a user deletes the last correct counting message.

params.name: mention
params.description: Mention of the user who's message got removed

params.name: number
params.description: Last counted number in this the channel

content.name: removeReactions
content.description: If enabled, the reactions the bot gives will be removed after 5 seconds. This will free up space in the counting channel

content.name: wrong-input-message
content.description: Message that gets send if a user provides an invalid input

params.name: err
params.description: Description of what they did wrong

content.name: strikeAmount
content.humanName: Amount of wrong messages to trigger action
content.description: This is the amount of wrong messages a user has to send to trigger action. Once this amount is reached, the bot will either, depending on your configuration, give a role or disable the SEND_MESSAGES permission for a user (set to 0 to disable)

content.name: giveRoleInsteadOfPermissionRemoval
content.humanName: Give role on action, instead of removing permission
content.description: If enabled, a role will be given to the user (once their reach the configured action amount of wrong messages) instead of the removal of the "Send Messages"-permission in the counter channel

content.name: strikeRole
content.humanName: Role given when amount is being reached
content.description: This role will be given to users when they reach the configured amount of wrong messages

content.name: strikeMessage
content.default: %mention%, I had to restrict your access to this channel because you repeatedly used it improperly.
content.description: This message will be sent when a user reach the configured amount of wrong messages and gets actioned

content.name: allowCharactersInMessage
content.description: If enabled, users may write additional content into their messages instead of forcing them to just write a number. Messages without a number will still lead to an error.

content.name: allowMaths
content.humanName: Allow users to use maths in their messages?
content.description: If enabled, users can use maths in messages, as long as the result of their formula is the correct next number.

content.name: enableEasterEggs
content.description: If enabled, the bot will react with special emojis on certain numbers (e.g. 42, 67, 69, 100, 420)
